snippet.title: Hark The Ghoul - Updated Demo Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Dive into the eerie depths of Hark the Ghoul where every twisted corridor and shadow-laced chamber is built to be discovered.

In the updated demo you’ll explore the damp, dark Victorian city under a starless sky, wield swords, whips, pistols and cannons, and employ magic to unravel haunting mysteries beneath the surface. With labyrinthine zones, unique gear, and a low-poly retro-modern aesthetic, this Souls-like dungeon-crawler from Deep Denizens and published by Kwalee invites you to slash, kick and magick your way through an immersive world.

The demo is now live — jump in, explore the depths, and wish-list the full game coming in 2026.
